title: Ca: Data breach at The Children’s Foundation
content_md: Tim Durkin reports: The Children’s Foundation has issued a privacy notice following a data breach involving its IT service provider, Highland Shores Children’s Aid Society. An unauthorized third party accessed the IT network on July 6, 2026 and encrypted systems before being detected on August 25.
